Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you.

Your first report of the kiosks offline on 3 Aug was at 10:42 AM. Between then and the recovery, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when Mateo logged that the guard checked in trailer 8836, and you confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07 AM.
